💥💥ATTENTION PLEASE💥💥
Something urgent has come to my attention. 

An artist I’ve known since the beginning of my XRPL journey is struggling. He was recently MIA and come to find out. After dealing with the flooding in the Philippines he had to pawn all his stuff to take care of his mothers medical bills and keep food on the table…

Please help me by either 
1. Like, share and comment some love!

2. Donate whatever you can to this wallet even if it’s 1 XRP.
